description: Stop all deliveries to one database webhook. Destructive: requires confirmed: true. Deleting an already deleted webhook answers not found. An optional idempotency_key makes a retry safe: the same key with the same request returns the stored answer, and the same key with another request is refused.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: database_webhook_delete
